newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai king appoints Chavalit's 49-member cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Thai king appoints Chavalit's 49-member cabinet.

text.p: Thailand's King Bhumibol Adulyadej on Friday issued a royal decree appointing the 49-member cabinet proposed by Prime Minister-designate Chavalit Yongchaiyudh, cabinet secretary-general Visanu Krua-ngam said.

The New Aspiration Party-led cabinet, which includes politicians from all six coalition partners, will be sworn in on December 1. Key cabinet members include Chavalit, who will be the country's 22nd prime minister and hold the defence portfolio, Amnuay Viravan as finance minister and Narongchai Akrasanee as commerce minister.

Amnuay, a respected economist and former finance minister, will also be deputy premier in charge of economic affairs. He and Naronghai, chairman of General Finance and Securities Plc, will be two of the unelected experts appointed under the NAP quota trying to revive Thailand's sagging economy.

The second largest coalition member, the Chart Pattana Party (CPP), will also have a role in industry and foreign trade. The charismatic but aging CPP leader, former premier Chatichai Choonhavan, will play an advisory role in economic and foreign relations, coalition sources said.
CPP deputy leader Korn Dabbaransi will be deputy prime minister and industry minister and Prachuab Chaiyasarn, also deputy CPP leader, will be foreign minister, Visanu said.

Chavalit, a former army chief, will supervise security issues and NAP secretary general Snoh Thienthong was named as interior minister. The Ministry of the Interior deals with all levels of social welfare issues, overseeing a police force of more than 200,000 and supervising elections.
